episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: When Pete and Maddie find out something devastating about their son Theo, they soon meet another set of parents in the same situation.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Pete and Maddie begin an expensive and painful fight to keep Theo, but the constant dredging up of their past starts to damage their relationship.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: When Miles leaks the story to the press, the fallout hits Pete who soon realises that he must dig into Miles' murky past to save his family.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: The conclusion of the psychological thriller series. The final court hearing looms and the boys' fate must be decided as Pete and Maddie look set to lose everything.
